note: Promotion to the tracked schema (roadmap Phase 1 backfill). Track groups follow the (XX) prefixes already embedded in the source theme names. Empty fields (track, code, level, description) are filled; authored transfer_check values replace ONLY the two known generic placeholder sentences — real source checks are never overwritten (guard in tools/normalize_blocks.py). v0.83.0 — every theme now carries `bands`, so the fill-empty path writes five authored sentences per theme (the same mechanism used for the community packs) instead of the shared sentence with its band suffix.
credential_correction: Credential correction (v0.52.0, proposed — not yet adopted by the review board): the v0.1.0 import named these tracks' credential with the bare band level 'Practitioner'. The `credential` on each track below replaces that level word only (real credential names are never overwritten); tools/normalize_blocks.py applies it as the one deliberate, counted exception to fill-empty-only and prints the count. Names follow the packs' own shape — a person and a capability, never a level word, never a job title the credential cannot confer.

themes.transfer_check: Run one small health habit anchored to an existing routine for two weeks, tracked without punishment, and report the streak honestly.

bands.K–2: Practice a healthy habit every day with an adult's reminder.
bands.3–5: Keep up a healthy habit for a week, with an adult's help.
bands.6–8: Build a real healthy habit that lasts a month, with a checker.
bands.9–10: Build and maintain a real healthy habit on your own, long term.
bands.11–12: Coach someone else on building a real habit that actually sticks.
